fields.statement: QA: built rhiza from 2c96751c5 to a scratch path and ran an autonomous plan run (fake claude/rex, real rhiza) whose round 3 left two review questions the arbiter passed. rhiza run status printed each as '— decision settle-…' with no 'not yet delivered', and run status --json questions carried no session field. go test ./internal/api -run TestRunInfoAcceptsAndQuestions and TestScripts/describe-golden pass.

QA: in the built binary, rhiza run review-check --rulings from the apply-rulings step exited 1 before the reviser linked anything, listing both questions with their Decision and the finding's node (export-csv, keep-flat); after the reviser linked each node decided-by its Decision it exited 0, listing both rulings with their decided-by node IDs, and --json gave a rulings array. Unset or unknown RHIZA_RUN and a finished run are refused with exit 2. go test ./internal/api -run TestRunReviewCheckRulings passes.

QA: rhiza guide plan-reviser from the built binary prints 'Applying the arbiter's rulings' under Must do, before Command budget, naming rhiza run status --json, the three decided-by cases, --record, never editing the Decision, and review-check --rulings. go test ./internal/guide -run TestPlanReviserText passes.

QA: in a hand-run autonomous plan run with the built binary, the arbiter for the round-3 question on export-csv (a leaf the serving draft created) started with RHIZA_CHANGE set to the serving draft, and the one on the landed Decision keep-flat started in the run's open change set. go test ./internal/run -run 'TestCommandAsked|TestArbitrate' and the run-review-check*, run-arbitrate-asked scripts pass.

QA: built binary, hand-run plan workflow: with a reviser that applies the rulings, check visit 3 passed to rulings, rulings visit 1 failed, apply-rulings visit 1 passed, rulings visit 2 passed, then gate. With a reviser that writes nothing, the run failed after rulings visit 2 (step apply-rulings over max_visits 1), with no gate step, and run status named both unapplied Decisions. go test ./internal/workflow -run 'TestPlanBuiltin|TestBuiltinPlanMilestone|TestBuiltinPlanReview' and the plan-workflow* scripts pass.
